base.changes.other: {n} changes to this page's own content.

base.none: Nothing there to pick (the kinds under Pick decide what can be picked).

base.refused.text: Color and line width can't be changed on lines drawn inside text.

base.refused.font: That text's font can't be written to here.
base.refused.gone: That object is no longer on the page.
base.refused.shading: A color blend fills its whole area, so it can't be moved on its own.
base.refused.other: That edit can't be written into this page ({why}).

hazop.note: Bring in the node boxes of a P&ID's HAZOP study (the file CadCraft's P&ID add-on exports as HAZOP node boxes). Each node becomes a rectangle on the open sheet with its number, name, equipment and lines, Open, ready for the team's findings as replies. The sheet is taken as printed at full size from the drawing's lower left corner; type another number if it was printed at another scale (0.5 for 1:2).
hazop.none: No HAZOP nodes in that file.
hazop.badscale: The print scale must be a number above zero.
hazop.subject: HAZOP

hazop.outside.one: {n} node falls outside the page and was not drawn.
